heading: INT. HAPPY PAWS VET CLINIC - NIGHT

units.text: INT. HAPPY PAWS VET CLINIC - NIGHT
CLOSE ON a keypad.
A gloved finger types four numbers.
A light turns green.
CLICK.
The front door swings open.
The clinic is dark and empty, except for the soft glow of a fish tank and a sleeping beagle in a cage.
AIDEN, 20s, in a black hoodie, leads the way.
Behind them comes SASHA, 20s, they/them, carrying a duffel bag, and MARLON, 30s, nervous, carrying a flashlight that he keeps pointing at his own face.
Marlon, the light.
units.name: AIDEN

units.text: Sorry. Sorry.
units.name: MARLON

units.text: WE SEE the three of them cross the waiting room.
Aiden checks a hand-drawn map.
Sasha stops at the fish tank and taps the glass, and Marlon trips on a chew toy that SQUEAKS loudly, and the beagle lifts its head, and all three freeze.
ANGLE ON the beagle.
It looks at them.
It yawns.
It goes back to sleep.
They're not even mad.
units.name: SASHA

units.text: Good. The safe is in Dr. Okafor's office. Down the hall, second door.
units.name: AIDEN

units.text: Why would a vet clinic have a safe?
units.name: MARLON

units.text: Because Okafor keeps the old man's ring in it. The one worth sixty thousand dollars.
units.name: AIDEN

units.text: You mean the ring he's been telling everyone is his dead wife's.
units.name: SASHA

units.text: Which it isn't. He bought it from the jeweler's two weeks after she left him. I have the receipt.
units.name: AIDEN

units.text: So we're not stealing it. We're, like, returning it.
units.name: MARLON

units.text: To who?
units.name: SASHA

units.text: To the universe.
units.name: MARLON

units.text: That is the worst plan I have ever heard, and I helped build the plan.
units.name: SASHA

units.text: Shh. Both of you.
units.name: AIDEN

units.text: They move down the hall.
Aiden pushes a door open, and Sasha slips inside.
Marlon waits at the threshold with the flashlight pointing at the floor like a good boy.
